description: This file contains unit tests for the SkillDao class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing CRUD operations and searches related to 'Skill' entities.

classes.name: SkillDaoTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing the SkillDao data access object methods within the OrangeHRM admin plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the SkillDao instance and populates test data from the specified YAML fixture before each test.

methods.name: testGetSkillById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Skill entity by its ID and verifies its name and description.

methods.name: testDeleteSkill
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple Skill entities by their IDs.

methods.name: testSearchSkill
methods.description: Tests searching for skills using default search filter parameters.

methods.name: testSearchSkillWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching for skills with a limit on the number of results.

methods.name: testSaveSkill
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new Skill entity.

methods.name: testEditSkill
methods.description: Tests editing an existing Skill entity and saving the changes.

methods.name: testGetSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests counting the total number of skills matching certain search parameters.
